notes.title: Update Notes for June 23, 2024
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes and Save File Update

SAVE SYSTEM
The save system now employs encryption.  This update will delete all previous save files.

BUG FIXES
[list]
[*]Third checkpoint in first level no longer loads player back in with portal disabled.
[*]Constructor boss was not firing its electrical attack when player was in proper range.  This calculation has been fixed.
[*]Quicksand will no longer allow the player to bypass and go underneath level.
[*]Attack detection range has been increased for constructor drones so they now attack if player is standing on top of them.
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 5/29/24 - Small Bug Fixes and New Game System
notes.notes:
[u]Pulsar Update System[/u]
-Players can now collect pulsar shards for the forge ( weapon ) and suit to upgrade their respective systems.  This replaces the old system of automatic upgrades.
-Spend points to unlock nodes in the Upgrade menu ( PRESS R1 or RB while in the player menu ).

[u]Minor Fixes[/u]
-Minor bug fix where the player would sometimes get load back in with "slow run speed" if dying while inside an IC-NME beam.

notes.title: Update Notes for May 9, 2024
notes.notes:
[list]

notes.title: Update 14 - May 2, 2024
notes.notes: - Fixed musicQueueIndex bug ( wasn't being reset on load )

notes.title: Update 13 - May 2, 2024
notes.notes:
- Fixed player sliding down steeper hills while aim locked
- Fixed issue where player was stuck in fall animation if standing on the very edge of a platform
- Cleaned up idle/run weapon animations
- IC-NME should no longer "Hug" the player ( thanks mono_nz! )
- Deadzone devices only deactivate now.  They cannot be turned back on.
- Added NPCinventory class so reward items now drop into game world instead of instant use.

notes.title: Update 12 - May 1, 2024
notes.notes:
- Added new art to Desert of Despair
- Added box colliders to Bird52 enemies so they can now take damage from melee weapons
- Fixed/nerfed dash.  If timed properly, the player could press jump and dash to perform a massive horizontal jump from a standstill.  ( I was able to bypass second section of the first level and jump over boundary walls using this technique. )

notes.title: Update 11 - April 30, 2024
notes.notes:
- Camera logic updated for better player tracking.
- Decreased defense on pulsar suit upgrades.

notes.title: Update 10 - April 30, 2024
notes.notes: Updates to the player menu interface.

notes.title: Update 9 - April 20th, 2024
notes.notes: - Controller detection added for playstation, xbox, and generic.  Now displays more accurate controller diagrams.

notes.title: Update 8 - April 29, 2024
notes.notes:
- New quick item swap system: You can now assign certain items to the D-Pad ( just health and RIP capsules for now - more interesting items planned for later release )

- Added a wall on Dimension 2 where a player could jump over the quick sand from D3 and shift into D2 to bypass all of section 2 of Desert of Despair.  ( Shout out to RareAchievements on twitch for finding this one and props for pulling it off )

- Fixed save bug where items would reappear in the inventory upon loading back in.

HAPPY TESTING!

notes.title: Update 7 - April 28th, 2024
notes.notes:
Updates:

- New quick item slotting added to HUD.  You can set/use the quick slots with the D-Pad ( all new controller layout graphics coming for xbox/playstation specific glyphs - this is very early version, graphic indicators in inventory to come / being able to view the d-pad layout when the menu is open )

- Race condition fixed between the camera and player controller load causing camera to become out of sync on the y-axis.

- Cactus question fix where all cactus items were disappearing when one was collected.

- Grammatical fix in tutorial.
